name: 1.5L Manual Hand Push Chopper & Multifunctional Mixer | Vegetable Chopper and Baby Food Maker
description:
Upgrade your kitchen prep with this 1.5-Liter Manual Hand Push Chopper and Multifunctional Mixer, designed to make chopping, grinding, and mixing faster, easier, and more efficient. From vegetables and fruits to meats and baby food, this versatile tool does it all—without the need for electricity!

Key Features
Easy to Use: Hand push design allows effortless chopping and mixing
Versatile Functionality: Works as a vegetable chopper, meat grinder, and baby food supplement maker
Durable Construction: Stainless steel blades with high-quality ABS, PP, and PS body for long-lasting performance
Transparent Container: Monitor chopping and mixing progress easily
Anti-Skid Base: Ensures stability during use, preventing slips and spills
Easy to Clean: Quick disassembly for hassle-free washing

Product Details
Capacity: 1.5 Liters
Material: Stainless steel blade, ABS + PP + PS body
Usage: Chopping vegetables, grinding meat, mixing batters, preparing baby food
Manual Operation: No electricity required
Ideal For: Household kitchens, meal prep, baby food, and small cooking tasks

Benefits
Saves time and effort in food preparation
Multi-functional tool for various kitchen tasks
Stable, safe, and convenient to use
Compact design perfect for home kitchens

What’s in the Box
1 × 1.5L Manual Hand Push Chopper & Multifunctional Mixer
